topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I heard tell that one of the young students from the far-off town, where the big house of learning stands, found their words shared all about. Their essay, which they poured their heart and thoughts into, now dances on pages they never meant to show. It’s like when a seed you’ve tended with care is taken by the wind, not to be returned. The peace of our valley, where words are kept close and shared under the church bells, feels far away. One can only hope the young one finds a way to mend what was unintended, perhaps through the grace of a saint or the wisdom of the elders.
